body:
Over time, attics get filled with junk and insulation quickly becomes a new home for rodents, mice, rats and other creatures. If you suspect there are or have been rats in your attic, then it’s time to call in the professionals. An attic cleanup job is not always fun…but it can be imperative for your health. DIY solutions, however, lack the meticulousness of professionals. There is also the risk that comes with such efforts. Sky Clean Air is the highest ranked Attic Cleaning Company in San Diego. In addition to cleaning, our knowledgeable staff can answer any questions you have before scheduling your appointment with us

When you have rats and mice in your attic, you’re storing much more than old Christmas boxes and clothing. You could be harboring a plethora of harmful diseases and health concerns such as:

  • Eosinophilic Meningitis
  • Hanta Virus
  • Leptospirosis
  • Lymphocytic Chorio-Meningitis
  • Murine Typhus
  • Omsk Hemorrhagic Fever
  • Parasites
  • Rat Bite Fever
  • Salmonella
  • The Plague
  • Tularemia
  • Unsanitary Conditions
